title: (RHBA-2015:0111) ews 2.1 tomcat6 bug fix update
portal_summary: Updated ews 2.1 tomcat6 packages that fix one bug are now available.

portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata relevant to your system have been applied.

This update is available via the Red Hat Network. Details on how to use the Red Hat Network to apply this update are available at
https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
JBoss Enterprise Web Server (JBEWS) is a fully integrated and certified set of components for hosting Java web applications. It is comprised of the Apache HTTP Server, the Apache Tomcat Servlet container, Apache Tomcat Connector (mod_jk), JBoss HTTP Connector (mod_cluster), Hibernate, and the Tomcat Native library.

This update fixes the following bug:

Previously, compiling a top-level domain (TLD) with an attribute containing
an empty string in custom tag in JavaServer Pages (JSP) resulted in an internal server error that prevented the server from fulfilling a request. To fix this bug, a patch has been applied, and compiling a JSP class containing an attribute with an empty string in custom tag no longer results in an error. (BZ#1161215)

Users of ews 2.1 tomcat6 are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which fix this bug.
